result.summary: Found 1 major visual/layout issue with a misplaced loading indicator, with no other critical defects after accounting for the allowed partial carousel items.

issues.description: A loading spinner icon is overlaid directly on the food image for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, blocking the restaurant's visual content and creating a cluttered, unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Move the loading spinner outside of the image content area, or hide it once the associated image/entry has fully loaded to avoid obscuring the restaurant's food photo.
